_comment: Blog manifest — the single source of truth for what agents may write. Each key is a collection: a directory under content/blog/ and a Paperclip project. Add collections as the app's content strategy takes shape; re-run `content.sh bootstrap <app>` after. Optional `route` (e.g. '/guides') gives a collection a top-level public URL for SEO/AEO — posts render at <route>/<slug> and /blogs/<key>/<slug> 308-redirects there; omit route to stay under /blogs. previewBase is repo convention (the dev port), not a machine path.

posts.name: Posts
posts.description: General blog posts — announcements, how-tos, product notes.
